newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi satisfied with market ERM reaction.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi satisfied with market ERM reaction.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister said on Monday he was happy with the market's reaction after the lira's re-entry into the European exchange rate mechanism at a central rate against the mark of 990 lire.
"I am very satisfied," Prodi told reporters while on a visit to this Northeast Italian city. "They tell me BTPs are faring well and futures too."
"If this is the true reaction of financial markets it means that it is believed that the steadiness of the Italian economy and the steadiness of the the lira are beyond discussion," he added.
The lire rose to 991 lire from 999 lire at the close on Friday before the weekend meeting of EU Finance Ministers which agreed on terms for the lira to go back into the ERM.

But both the lira and BTPs later took a knock before quickly recovering on news that a public prosecutor was seeking trial for Prodi for alleged "abuse of office" while chairman of Italian state industry conglomerate IRI. Rome newsroom +396-6782560
